cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?
